needs_human.note: The header's accessible name gains spaces between title, count and scene count on every video (Presenter.tsx:228-231). The spec does not describe this.; The `.loft` mount path (Container.tsx:242) sets `changes` but never resets `frameMode` when the answer has no changes. Mode is reset on file change, and a `.loft` never re-fetches on expand, so this is not reachable today.
The header button's accessible name and textContent now have spaces between the title, the bare count and the visual count. No spec requires this. Only the new test relies on it.
